role: Domain 2 R4-fix (zombie competition and zombie mimics: HRZ_Grindo_Holics, GSA_callfart, AVI_AnotherBitInTheWall) - defensive fix in the base

mechanism.weakness: rev0 A spends its single INT 87h on E2 F2 81 C3 searched forward from 1000:0000, so the lowest copy wins. Grindo/callfart dead-code mimics and INT 86h planters below zom20a absorb the capture and the b/d chain behind it (B052, B062).
mechanism.fix: Location-based capture. zom20a (2 opcodes/round, AX=L, BX=0 at load) runs inc cx; jmp; add bx,10E1h; mul bx; mov [1243h],dx, so it stores v1 = hi(L*10E1h) in round 3 and overwrites it only in round 6. A reads [1243h] at its instruction 4 (round 4, valid for either execution order) and starts the forward search at DI = 15*v1 (MUL, cannot fault). For every legal load L, L-DI is in [12,723] (checked for all L), below the engine's 1024-byte MIN_GAP, so no other warrior's initial code lies between DI and zom20a's window at L+2Bh. Without zom20a, or with a poisoned cell, DI is just another start point; without decoys every start finds zom20a (the search wraps the full 64 KiB), so the change only matters when decoys exist.
mechanism.engineFacts: War.nextRound: zombies run options.zombieSpeed=2 opcodes per round (ZOMBIE_H only if the name ends in h); survivors with energy 0 never get an extra opcode, so A's instruction k runs in round k. INT 87h gives no location feedback (Cpu.int87).
mechanism.staticScan: scratch/B082/scan1243.cjs: [1243h] is READ by GSA_GoonSquad1, HDS_YOY2, WAN_Baltika91, TOM_2B2Team2, OST_Gamma1, HLS_EmoMutants2, GSA_callfart1 (the zom20a location leak is known in the 2025 field). It is WRITTEN early by OHS_TrojanByte2 (mov word [1243h],2934h at instr 3), GSA_callfart2 (mov [1243h],dx at instr 3 AND 4, covering both execution orders of rounds 3-4), TOM_Syntax_Terror1 (CCCCh at instr 6, after our read), HRZ_L2 (instr 5, after our read).

Below the +0.006 ALL bar; marked promising only under the defense-fix rule (clear threat gain, no clearly negative group).

counterCodes.strength: Existing 2025 code that already defeats this fix: writes [1243h] at its instructions 3 and 4, so A reads 0 and searches from 0 (= rev0). tmbm1 callfart -0.015 n.s. A purpose-built counter would be callfart2's two writes plus Grindo-style decoys or a B052 planter (not built).

recommendation: locA2 is a candidate defense fix, not a confirmed improvement. It removes the Grindo/planter zom20a-mimic weakness (+0.15 vs Grindo in 12/12 threat cohorts, +0.15/+0.275 vs the B052 planter). General cost on screen S looks small: ALL +0.0057 [-0.0033,+0.0148], 2025 +0.004, strong -0.005 (n.s.). That is just below the +0.006 screen bar, so it is not a stand-alone promotion. Expected field value is about +0.005..0.01 on 2025-like fields and 0 elsewhere. It does not help against callfart, which poisons [1243h] at instructions 3-4. Best use: put it in the next combination. It changes only A's startup (instructions 1-11) and is compatible with SD (template), Z1 (B zombie paths) and B054 fix2steal (B). Merging with A024 C2 (also A startup) is possible: locA2 has two nop turns (19-20) that can carry C2's decoy writes, and C2's stripped tail is independent. Keep the [9769h] copy at or before instruction 8.
